jobs.occupation: Batteries und Sub-Station Delivery Project Manager and Portfolio Expert (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Batterietechnik)
jobs.description:
E.ON Energy Projects GmbH (EEP) designs, finances, builds, operates and optimises decentralised, large-scale power generation plants for industrial customers. Since 2000, we realised projects of more than 1 gigawatt across Europe. With our bespoke integrated solutions, we drive decarbonisation and digitalisation in the energy-intensive industries.
At E.ON diversity matters. We welcome all people and are convinced that differences make us stronger. Become part of our inclusive and diverse company culture! To create equal opportunities for everyone we offer our positions in full- or part-time.
Ready to become a Playmaker of the energy transition? Join our team in München and apply online as Batteries und Sub-Station Delivery Project Manager and Portfolio Expert (f/m/d). Are you brave enough to drive progress and forge new paths? Let’s make it work and create real impact together. We can’t wait to meet you! It’s on us, to make new energy work.

Responsibilities

- This role operates within a dual reporting structure, reporting to the Implementation Department at E.ON Energy Projects GmbH and to the CTO-led Solutions Portfolio department within the central function of E.ON Energy Infrastructure Solutions (EIS).
- Delivery of large-scale Batteries and sub-station CAPEX projects across Europe, starting in the development phase through to handover to operations, with responsibility for safety, scope, cost, timeline, performance, and quality
- Overall leadership of an integrated project team with subject-matter experts to drive the development and execution of the projects, covering project management, contract and risk management, project controls, permitting, engineering, construction, commissioning, procurement, and claim management, as well as internal and external stakeholder management
- Support the International Batteries Pipeline Manager in applying a structured portfolio management approach, by proactively coordinating with other project managers across regions to identify risks, gaps, and interdependencies
- Provide technical and delivery assurance across multiple BESS projects, ensuring alignment on scope, quality, schedule, and budget; review and challenge project plans and critical paths, identify risks early, and define corrective actions
- Validate engineering designs, studies, and commissioning strategies to ensure technically robust and cost-efficient solutions, and engage hands-on in resolving critical technical and delivery issues
- Support the development of standardisation, best practices, and lessons learned across the portfolio, building on existing capabilities within the Group
Requirements
- Degree in electrical engineering or related field, with senior-level BESS and/or power infrastructure project delivery experience, ideally including integrated BESS and substation projects
- Proven experience in managing multiple projects in parallel, with a structured approach to project management and project controls
- Proven cross-country stakeholder coordination, communication, and influence across project teams, suppliers, EPC partners, and other stakeholders
- Strong BESS technical expertise
- Solid understanding of BESS cost drivers and EPC delivery models, with commercial, hands-on, and continuous improvement mindset
- Fluent in German and English (C1); Willingness to travel (20-40%)
Benefits
- High flexibility: Make work fit your personal life with our hybrid working model, flexible hours, and job-sharing options
- More freedom: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave plus extra days off, and find your balance with options like a 4.5-day week, a sabbatical, extra time, or extra pay
- Workation included: Make Europe your office and work up to 20 days per year from inspiring locations across the EU
- Corporate benefits: Secure your future with benefits including company pension schemes, our share programme, a range of insurance packages, and much more
- Culture of innovation: Share your ideas and unleash creativity in a collaborative, interdisciplinary environment with flat hierarchies
- Family support: Manage family life – from paid family start leave, childcare and holiday programs, to daily assistance for family members
- Modern workplace: Enjoy a multifunctional workspace that combines cutting-edge digital technology with ergonomic comfort for productivity and collaboration
- Strong team spirit: Celebrate successes and connect with colleagues at our company and team events
- Personal growth: Unlock your potential through continuous learning, diverse development opportunities, and personalized training or mentoring
- Holistic health: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with our sports, fitness, wellness, nutrition, meditation, physiotherapy, and preventive healthcare offerings
- Individual mobility: Travel your way with flexible options such as car and bike leasing, or a subsidised Deutschlandticket for public transport
- Culinary offering: Enjoy fresh, balanced meals, snacks, and drinks at many office locations with our subsidised canteen

Do you have questions?
For further information please contact Kyra Temma, kyra.temma@eon.com. Are you already convinced that this is the next step in your career? If yes, we would be happy if you would register and apply online (Job ID 246062). Just a quick note: Please only use our official application portal to apply. Unfortunately, we can't consider applications sent via email. We really appreciate your understanding!
What you need to know:
Contract type: Permanent
Work Model: Hybrid
Working time: Full time; Part time
Company: E.ON Energy Projects GmbH
Location: München
Function area: Project/Program Management

It is important to us that people with disabilities have access to a fair application process, providing them with an opportunity to shine. The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

We are looking for an IT Security Specialist to define security standards for two major data infrastructure projects in the Heidelberg-Mannheim region: (1) The Data Space Project (https://www.health-life-sciences.de/dataspace/)  of the Health + Life Science Alliance (http://www.health-life-sciences.de/) has recently been launched to develop a trusted research environment (TRE) for seven leading life sciences and biomedical research institutions in the Heidelberg-Mannheim region. These infrastructures are supporting the bioinformatics community with software tools for secure data/metadata storage, interactive data portals with data visualization, and streamlined data deposition and acquisition solutions. Prof. Oliver Stegle is coordinating GHGA at the DKFZ and representing the Data Space project for the DKFZ in close collaboration with the other Health + Life Science Alliance member institutions Heidelberg University, European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL), Central Institute of Mental Health, Max Planck Institute for Medical Research, Heidelberg University Hospital and University Hospital Mannheim.

Your expertise will help ensure the safe operation of the Data Space TRE and GHGA while also contributing to the development of standards in Germany and supporting their role in international efforts.

- Coordination of interaction with external expertise on legal and technical IT security topics

Your Profile:

Essential Expertise:

- Proven experience with core information security frameworks (BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001) and risk management methodologies
- Hands-on background in developing and implementing risk-mitigation plans, security policies, processes, and technical controls
- Solid understanding of GDPR compliance requirements and IT infrastructure fundamentals (e.g., networking, server roles, system architecture)
- Fluency in German and English to articulate technical requirements clearly and collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners
- Demonstrated project management skills, with the ability to work independently, solve problems creatively, and drive initiatives to completion

jobs.occupation: Senior Developer (f/m/d) for SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning - eSPP and PP/DS (ERP-Anwendungsentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. 
 
What you’ll do: 

Are you ready to take a senior engineering role in shaping mission-critical planning solutions at the heart of the world’s leading enterprise software company? This is an opportunity to contribute to SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning, with a focus on both SAP Extended Service Parts Planning (eSPP) and Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS). Together, these solutions help customers plan complex supply chains, optimize service levels, production resources, material availability, and operational execution across industries. 

You will work on business-critical planning capabilities used by customers with large service parts, manufacturing, warehouse, dealer, and distribution networks. Our roadmap includes modern SAP Fiori user experiences, advanced planning algorithms, forecasting, inventory planning, detailed scheduling, simulation, analytics, integration with SAP S/4HANA capabilities such as aATP, and the next wave of AI-assisted planning, optimization, and navigation. 

As a Senior Developer in our SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning team, you will: 

- Own the design, implementation, testing, and delivery of complex features across eSPP and PP/DS, with responsibility for quality, maintainability, performance, and long-term product standard compliance. 
- Apply your strong C++ background to analyze and evolve planning and optimization-related components, while also working with SAP technologies such as ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, and SAP S/4HANA integration patterns. 
- Contribute to capabilities for service parts planning, production planning, detailed scheduling, forecasting, inventory planning, stocking and destocking decisions, simulation, mass maintenance, analytics, and integration with adjacent SAP solutions. 
- Drive technical concepts, architectural improvements, refactoring, automated tests, code reviews, root-cause analysis, and defect prevention for mission-critical private cloud products. 
- Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, quality engineers, product management, and development colleagues across locations to translate customer and roadmap requirements into reliable, scalable, and user-oriented solutions. 
- Act as a technical role model for less experienced developers by sharing knowledge, reviewing designs and code, and helping the team continuously improve engineering practices. 
- Help shape the next generation of planning capabilities, including AI-assisted planning experiences, Joule-based contextual assistance, embedded analytics, and modern SAP Fiori user experiences. 
 
What you bring: 
- A good to excellent university degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Natural Sciences, or a related field. 
- Several years of professional software development experience, ideally in enterprise software, planning, optimization, logistics, supply chain, or manufacturing-related domains. 
- A strong C++ background is required, including solid understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, debugging, performance analysis, and maintainable code design. 
- Experience with SAP technologies such as ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, or SAP S/4HANA architecture is a strong plus; willingness to broaden your expertise across the SAP technology stack is expected. 
- Experience or strong interest in PP/DS, eSPP, Production Planning, Materials Management, service parts planning, detailed scheduling, or related supply chain planning processes. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex planning algorithms, business processes, and customer scenarios. 
- A senior mindset: ownership, technical leadership, high quality standards, clear communication, constructive collaboration, and the ability to guide others while remaining hands-on. 
- Fluent communication skills in English; German language skills are beneficial. 

Tech & topics you will work with 

- You will deepen and apply your expertise in SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning, with focus on both SAP Extended Service Parts Planning (eSPP) and Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS). 
- You will work across C++, ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, SAP S/4HANA integration, analytics, and development practices used in mission-critical private cloud products. 
- You will contribute to planning and optimization capabilities, including forecasting, inventory planning, detailed scheduling, simulation, advanced analytics, AI-assisted planning, enterprise search, Joule-based assistance, and guided planning experiences. 
 
Meet the team: 

This senior role offers the opportunity to take technical ownership in strategic SAP planning solutions that help customers run complex after-sales, manufacturing, and supply chain planning processes more efficiently, transparently, and intelligently. You will contribute to the evolution of both eSPP and PP/DS while growing as a recognized expert in SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning. 
 

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.  

We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program (https://one.int.sap/me@sap/jobs_and_hiring/employee_referral/region/0000/lang/en) , according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

jobs.occupation: Flight Test Ground Station Systems Architect (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the Flight Test Ground Station Germany Team Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Flight Test Ground Station Systems Architect (m/w/d)

** Your location**

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

** Our Benefits for You**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

** Your tasks and responsibilities**

As a Systems & Software Architect for the Flight Test Ground Station (FTGS)

- you will lead the end-to-end architectural lifecycle for a complex suite of flight test tools, including FTGS-Core, FIDA, and various Add-On tools.
- you will be responsible for defining and documenting comprehensive system requirements, balancing operational needs, technical constraints, and stringent regulatory requirements.
- your core mission involves developing and iterating robust architectures encompassing hardware, software, and network infrastructure.
- Utilizing established architectural patterns and best practices, you will design modular, scalable systems and produce high-quality design specifications, interface definitions, and technical documentation.
- You will play a decisive role in evaluating and selecting the technologies and components necessary for successful system implementation, ensuring seamless interoperability and compatibility between various subsystems and external interfaces.
- Beyond design, you will drive technical excellence by establishing development best practices, conducting detailed design studies, and overseeing validation and verification (V&V) strategies. You will actively support the system integration process and contribute to the creation of test strategies to validate architecture and performance.

Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. We are seeking an accomplished Scientist to advance our mission of delivering disease-modifying therapies to patients with liver cirrhosis.
As Principal Scientist, you will lead a team of lab scientists and take ownership of identifying and advancing novel therapeutic approaches — from target identification through to candidate selection. A deep understanding of liver physiology and expert knowledge of disease-relevant cellular and tissue models will set you up for success in this role.
Join us and drive innovative drug discovery projects within our Cardio-Renal-Metabolic Diseases Research Department, located at Boehringer Ingelheim's largest R&D site in Biberach an der Riss, Germany. You will work alongside talented colleagues, access cutting-edge technology, and help shape the future of liver disease therapy
Tasks & responsibilities

- Manage an in vitro pharmacology lab and mentor a team of highly skilled lab scientists, fostering a collaborative environment and actively developing the skills of your team members.
- Apply innovative in vitro and ex vivo models that reflect human liver disease conditions to identify promising drug candidates.
- Build the evidence base to translate therapeutic concepts from preclinical models to patients, leveraging experimental models and data science tools.
- Navigate effectively within a matrix-based environment, collaborating across disciplines including Medicinal Chemistry, Biologics Development, Drug Discovery Support functions, Computational Innovation, and Experimental Medicine.
- Enable decision making by communicating complex results efficiently to stakeholders.
- Maintain a strong external network, manage external collaborations, and contribute to advancing the science of liver cirrhosis by publishing papers and presenting at scientific conferences

Requirements

- Doctorate (PhD) in biology, biochemistry, or molecular pharmacology, with expert knowledge in liver physiology specifically the pathophysiology of cirrhosis complications. Knowledge of alcohol-associated liver cirrhosis is a plus.
- Multiple years of drug discovery experience in a pharmaceutical industry setting, with demonstrated expertise spanning target identification through to candidate selection. Proficiency in cell-based methods (primary cells, organotypic cultures) to model liver disease conditions in vitro/ex vivo. Skilled in molecular, cellular and biochemical profiling techniques.
- Proven line-management and leadership skills, including setting and evaluating objectives and advancing the development of team members.
